browser: Installed stable Google Chrome 156/157 (headless, temporary profile) driven over the DevTools protocol with trusted keyboard, mouse and touch events, plus the Claude desktop app's built-in browser pane (Chromium) for Magnet Marauder's tap, language, phone and select checks. Visible DOM text and screenshots were read; no game state was read or injected; Playwright was not used.
savedProgressSeeding: Later levels were reached by writing the host's own saved-progress preference (localStorage pixel-arcade-v1 levels[id]), which is what a returning player has; game state was never touched. Seeded progress was removed from the built-in pane afterwards.

observed: A pixel-reading driver that follows the prompt and the red lock bracket cleared chambers 1 to 16 back to back in 145 s, then won chamber 25 on the first attempt for 2180: 'All 25 chambers cleared: the foundry is yours!'.
Idle play lost chamber 1 with 'Enemies wrecked the machinery. Hit them before their wind-up ends.'; arrows and X on the loss screen changed nothing; Play again restarted chamber 1 with full machines.
P paused and resumed. The host pauses whenever the page is hidden, as designed.
Chinese portrait phone: HUD, prompts and the six touch buttons are translated; the touch Left button moved the chamber highlight and Repel started chamber 24.
Chamber select (9x3 grid) shows no text over any cell in English desktop or Chinese phone layouts.
Landscape fullscreen places the controls in side columns.
Earlier 3-chamber builds produced the findings listed in reviews.json; an earlier select layout overlapped cell 25 in English and was fixed.
minorOpen: While the chamber chooser is open the status line still shows the chamber 1 lesson instead of announcing the chooser.

observed: A driver that reads the drawn wall tiles, pings sparingly and follows the prompt cleared caverns 1 to 3.
Cavern 20 opened from the chooser with saved progress; the driver recovered 3 of 5 beacon beetles before crawlers ended the run, and the loss screen froze input.
Chinese portrait touch ping showed the chase prompt; landscape fullscreen placed controls in side columns.
minorOpen: The cavern chooser is not announced in the status line.

observed: Workshop 1 repaired from a fresh start and workshop 8 repaired after choosing it in the select screen.
Workshop 16 was played to an engine-seize loss by a slow driver; Play again then started the furthest unlocked workshop, as designed.
Idle play on workshop 1 lost with 'The engine froze solid. Warm parts faster next time.' and input stayed frozen.
Chinese portrait touch and landscape fullscreen layouts work.
A prompt-following driver won all 22 rooms (5400), continuing through the vault menu after host pauses; the win screen froze input.
Chinese portrait touch continued at room 22; landscape fullscreen placed controls in side columns.

notTested: Physical devices, other browsers and audio quality.
